Scrip Code: HERITGFOOD 
 
Sub:  Audio Recording link - Conference call held on October 16, 2026 - reg 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In continuation of our letter dated October 7, 2026, the Company had organized a conference 
call with the Investors/Analysts on Friday, October 16, 2026 at 11.00 AM (IST). Pursuant to 
the provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the Investors Conference Call on the  
Un-Audited Financial Result for the period ended September 30, 2026 is available on the 
Company’s website at www.heritagefoods.in. No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information was 
disclosed/shared to the Investors/Analysts during the meeting/call. 
 
The link to access the said recording is: 
https://www.heritagefoods.in/uploads/investors/pdf/Audio-Q2-FY27-Earnings%20Call-16102026.mp3  
 
Kindly take the same on record and display the same on the website of your exchange.  
 
Thanks & Regards, 
 
For HERITAGE FOODS LIMITED 
 
 
UMAKANTA BARIK 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
M No: FCS-6317 
 
UMAKANT
A BARIK
Digitally signed by 
UMAKANTA BARIK 
Date: 2026.10.16 
14:18:07 +05'30'
